parsed.explanation: Worst features are tier-1 universal exposures enforced by institutions themselves: single-sex spaces code in force excluding trans people, hospital ward bans (with a documented death after ward removal), birth-sex strip-search and custody placement. These follow every outed traveller regardless of enforcement frequency. Offsetting: no criminalisation, retained gender-reassignment discrimination protection, functioning courts with live challenges, no documented police violence or killings, generally tolerant society (LGB polls only). Anti-trans media hostility and the sharply falling equality ranking raise social-friction exposure to hostility rather than mere friction. Severity peaks at severe (care denial, invasive search), not catastrophic; rule of law partly mitigates but hostile institutional practice is rated as exposure. Subnational variation modestly averages the picture.
